enablement.installation: Helm sync.enabled=true, rollout.enabled=true and exact rollout.allowedDeployments; --enable-rollout must match administrative rolloutEnabled and requires --enable-sync
enablement.authorization: Every requested name must be in both the Store binding allowlist and the independent installation allowlist

eligibility.trigger: A complete currently verified snapshot changes selected data bytes of an existing managed Secret
eligibility.equalData: Preserve opaque revision and do not create new eligibility, including equal plaintext in a newly encrypted canonical envelope
eligibility.enableOrResume: Does not create historical eligibility. Generation/context changes invalidate older pending intent
eligibility.revision: Random opaque 128-bit identifier, not a plaintext hash
eligibility.atomicTargetWrite: Complete data, revision, accepted checkpoint and exact intent annotation are written together after protected authorization CAS

protectedAuthority.location: Existing UID-pinned state Secret state.json; Record.rollout is optional for older state
protectedAuthority.authorization: Full versioned intent, canonical metadata hash, cancelled flag and per-Deployment applied receipts
binding: exact Deployment names and observed UIDs
protectedAuthority.order: Persist prepared authorization before target write. Before every workload patch, confirm protected exact head, target UID, verified target bytes and matching public revision/intent
protectedAuthority.untrustedMarkers: Public Secret/Deployment annotations cannot create or reconstruct eligibility. Forged, missing or mismatched authority fails closed
protectedAuthority.completion: Applied receipts prevent a removed or altered completion annotation from causing another patch for the same authorization
protectedAuthority.partialWrite: Crash after patch before receipt may recover from the exact existing marker. Ambiguous state-ahead/target-ahead writes fail closed and can require administrative repair
protectedAuthority.formatting: Guard and Result String/GoString redact captured verified values

deployment.consumption: Actual envFrom.secretRef, env.valueFrom.secretKeyRef, or mounted Secret/projected Secret volume in regular or init containers. Unmounted volumes, labels and imagePullSecrets do not count
deployment.identity: A known UID is not repinned within the same CR/Store generation context and target-name list, even after completion/cancellation or public marker tampering
deployment.reauthorization: Changing CR/Store generation is a new administrative authorization context and may establish current Deployment UIDs. Hostile namespace multi-tenancy is not supported
deployment.deferredObservation: If an authorized data update cannot observe a Deployment UID, its protected candidate can resolve the exact allowed name once after fresh verification. This first observation may restart an application created after the Secret update; no creation-time freshness heuristic is claimed
deployment.patch: Fresh uncached GET, JSON Patch tests for exact UID and resourceVersion, then only own Pod-template annotation
deployment.paused: Block workload patch while preserving successful Secret synchronization
deployment.progress: Observe current generation and replica convergence. An old failed generation does not block one attempt for a new authorized revision; a current failed revision is not repeatedly patched

debounce.scope: One binding/target Secret, not a transaction across several Secrets
debounce.deadline: min(last actual change + 5s, first incomplete authorized change + 30s)
debounce.persistence: Intent timestamps are durable; operator restart does not reset the deadline

sourceFailures.availability: Panel/witness outage, sealed panel or rate limiting freezes pending E2E2 rollout. Every retry requires a new successful strict-current Reader; no cached proof fallback
sourceFailures.terminalDenial: Explicit fixed AccessDenied/AuthenticationDenied/ScopeDenied invalidates the matching protected pending authorization; stale cancellation cannot cancel a newer context
sourceFailures.suspendOrDelete: No source fetch or workload patch. The next context must match before any pending rollout can execute

status: DataCurrent describes verified Secret synchronization; RolloutReady independently describes requested rollout authorization/progress. Ready requires both when rollout is requested
rbac: Only when enabled: apps/deployments get and patch with exact resourceNames. No Deployment update/list/watch, scale or Pod-delete grants
coexistence: Choose one controller to restart a given application for this Secret. Existing external reloaders can independently cause extra restarts; the operator does not change their configuration. The E2E fixture explicitly opts out of Stakater Reloader only on its own Deployment
limitations: No cross-object atomic transaction or exactly-once rollout guarantee
No instantaneous revocation/fencing or HA guarantee; these remain for stage 6
Development filesystem witness is not WORM and does not prove independent production restore storage
No automatic recovery/reset from lost protected state or replaced target identity
Older stage-4 binaries may reject the additional state fields; downgrade migration/release compatibility is not claimed
No production deployment, publication or stage-6 work is authorized by this result
